title: Unusual undecanuclear heterobimetallic Zn4Ln7 (Ln = Gd, Dy) nano-sized clusters encapsulating two peroxide anions through spontaneous intake of dioxygen

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, a methanolic solution of triethylamine (0.65 mL, 0.30 mmol) was added to H2L (0.20 mmol, 51 mg) dissolved in 8 mL of methanol with continuous stirring. After 30 min, solid Gd(ClO4)3·6H2O (0.10 mmol, 59 mg) was added and the mixture was stirred for 2 h. Solid ZnCl2 (0.40 mmol, 52 mg) was then added and stirring continued for 3 h. Acetonitrile (18 mL) was added, the mixture was filtered, and the filtrate was left undisturbed for slow evaporation. Yellow stick crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction formed after about 12 days, were filtered, washed with methanol and acetonitrile, and air-dried.

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility of 1 is consistent with seven weakly antiferromagnetically coupled Gd(III) ions (χMT = 52.76 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K vs 55.13 expected; 28.85 cm3 mol−1 K at low T). Magnetization at 2 K and 7.0 T reaches 44.36 μB (vs 49.0 μB for seven uncoupled Gd(III)). The Gd analogue shows a magnetocaloric effect with −ΔSm max = 21.46 J kg−1 K−1 at 3 K for ΔH = 7 T, smaller than the 30.92 J kg−1 K−1 theoretical value because of antiferromagnetic Gd–Gd coupling and diamagnetic Zn(II).

synthesis.procedure: Prepared as for 1 except Dy(ClO4)3·6H2O (0.10 mmol, 62 mg) replaced Gd(ClO4)3·6H2O. Under aerobic conditions: triethylamine (0.65 mL, 0.30 mmol) added to H2L (0.20 mmol, 51 mg) in 8 mL methanol; after 30 min the Dy salt was added and stirred 2 h; ZnCl2 (0.40 mmol, 52 mg) added and stirred 3 h; 18 mL acetonitrile added, filtered, and the filtrate evaporated slowly to give yellow stick crystals (washed with methanol and acetonitrile, air-dried).

properties.summary: χMT of 2 is 101.92 cm3 mol−1 K at room temperature (99.19 expected for seven uncorrelated Dy(III)) and falls to 65.90 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K. M vs H/T plots are not superimposable, indicating anisotropy and/or low-lying excited states. Ac susceptibility under zero dc field and 3 Oe ac field shows frequency- and temperature-dependent χ″ below 8 K (slow relaxation / SMM-like behaviour with QTM). Arrhenius analysis of frequency-dependent data gives Ueff = 11.2 K and τ0 = 4.18×10−6 s; a fit including QTM gives Ueff = 19.5 K, τ0 = 4.3×10−7 s and τQTM = 1.7×10−4 s.
